input: Um, hi everyone, thanks for joining the call today. I wanted to give a quick summary of where the warehouse project stands before we break for the holiday. Um, in the meantime, we are going to store the overflow in the rented unit across the street, which costs a little more than we planned but keeps the orders moving. The second thing is staffing. We hired four seasonal workers, and they start training next week with Helga, who has done this for, uh, six years now. The third thing is the scanner software. It crashed twice on Tuesday, and the vendor promised a patch by Friday, so please write down any order that fails to scan and send the list to me at the end of each shift. That is everything from my side, so, um, let me know if you have questions, and enjoy the break.
